runner_convention_breaker.name: The Catalyst
runner_convention_breaker.description: A runner who slipped past your outer perimeter on their first attempt. Do not underestimate them.

runner_loup_party_animal.name: Rene Loup Arcemont
runner_loup_party_animal.description: Anarch. Chaotic. Willing to let a fermenter rot in your servers just to watch them burn.

runner_zahya_versatile_smuggler.name: Zahya Sadeghi
runner_zahya_versatile_smuggler.description: Criminal. Every jailbreak attempt pays her dividends. Every run is a business transaction.

runner_tao_telepresence_magician.name: Tao Salonga
runner_tao_telepresence_magician.description: Shaper. Methodical. She rearranges your ICE like furniture and walks through anyway.

runner_loup_project_crow.name: Project Crow
runner_loup_project_crow.description: Loup operating with more patience than usual. More dangerous for it.

runner_tao_street_tricks.name: Street Tricks
runner_tao_street_tricks.description: Tao running a leaner, faster configuration. She hits hard on the first approach.

runner_zahya_getaway.name: Getaway
runner_zahya_getaway.description: Zahya running a smash-and-grab configuration. She does not plan to stay long.

runner_loup_devourer.name: Devourer
runner_loup_devourer.description: A viral payload that grows with every server it touches. Purge and watch it come back.

runner_ryo_anger_issues.name: Anger Issues
runner_ryo_anger_issues.description: Ryo. She does not break ICE so much as bludgeon it into submission.

runner_topan_prick_thyself.name: Prick Thyself
runner_topan_prick_thyself.description: Topan. Organizer. Every successful run seeds the next.

runner_zahya_tickets_please.name: Tickets Please
runner_zahya_tickets_please.description: Zahya pivoting to access-on-demand. Every card she steals is another door opened.

runner_muslihat_shootin_and_lootin.name: Shootin and Lootin
runner_muslihat_shootin_and_lootin.description: MuslihaT. She buys and sells access to your servers like a market stall.

runner_barry_professional_opportunities.name: Professional Opportunities
runner_barry_professional_opportunities.description: Barry. Tri-Maf. Running your servers is just another job to him.

runner_tao_flow_and_ebb.name: Flow and Ebb
runner_tao_flow_and_ebb.description: Tao. Ritualistic. She runs in patterns. Find the pattern. Break it.

runner_dewi_enthusiasm.name: Enthusiasm
runner_dewi_enthusiasm.description: Dewi. Academic. She is studying your ICE. She is taking notes.

runner_magdalene_sabbatical.name: Sabbatical
runner_magdalene_sabbatical.description: Magdalene. Architect. She does not rush. She builds her way in.

runner_magdalene_drone_warfare.name: Drone Warfare
runner_magdalene_drone_warfare.description: Magdalene has upgraded her infrastructure. Your servers have never faced this.

runner_topan_they_are_huge.name: They Are Huge With It
runner_topan_they_are_huge.description: Topan. Maximalist. She is bringing every tool she has.

runner_tao_a_rising_tide.name: A Rising Tide Breaks All ICE
runner_tao_a_rising_tide.description: Tao. Running a deck built around one principle: ICE is temporary.

runner_hiram_sourdough_starter.name: Sourdough Starter
runner_hiram_sourdough_starter.description: Hiram. Shadow of the Past. He runs on legacy code no one else understands anymore.

runner_zahya_hare_song.name: Hare Song
runner_zahya_hare_song.description: Zahya. Elusive. She slips through gaps before your ICE can fully rez.

runner_ryo_regulation_breaker.name: Regulation Breaker
runner_ryo_regulation_breaker.description: Ryo. Her anger has been refined. She runs with purpose now. That is worse.

runner_muslihat_negative_marketing.name: Negative Marketing Campaign
runner_muslihat_negative_marketing.description: MuslihaT. She is not just running your servers. She is running a campaign against you.

runner_az_blueberry_breakers.name: Blueberry Breakers
runner_az_blueberry_breakers.description: Az McCaffrey. Works smarter. Every install is a dividend.

runner_lat_lateral_thinking.name: Lateral Thinking
runner_lat_lateral_thinking.description: Lat. Freelancer. Thinks sideways through your ICE.

runner_zahya_lucky_switch.name: Lucky Switch
runner_zahya_lucky_switch.description: Zahya. Fast hands. She flips your ICE before it can fire.

runner_ryo_fizzy_phoenix.name: Fizzy Phoenix
runner_ryo_fizzy_phoenix.description: Ryo. She comes back more dangerous each time. Plan accordingly.

runner_topan_demolished.name: Demolished
runner_topan_demolished.description: Topan. No more subtlety. She is tearing your walls down.

runner_dewi_groovy.name: Groovy Dewi
runner_dewi_groovy.description: Dewi. She has found her rhythm. Every run builds on the last.

runner_hiram_cybertrooper_pauli.name: Cybertrooper Pauli
runner_hiram_cybertrooper_pauli.description: Hiram. Ghost in the system. Cordyceps everywhere. Pull one thread and the network unravels.

runner_tao_daily_plasticity.name: Daily Plasticity
runner_tao_daily_plasticity.description: Tao. Evolving. Every run she reconfigures. You cannot plan for her.

runner_az_prognostic_boomerang.name: Prognostic Boomerang
runner_az_prognostic_boomerang.description: Az. Every card she installs bounces back as a weapon.

runner_barry_lucky_bravado.name: Lucky Bravado
runner_barry_lucky_bravado.description: Barry. He runs like every score is a payday. Because it is.

runner_loup_trickster_paladin.name: Trickster Paladin
runner_loup_trickster_paladin.description: Loup. Running on faith and counters. The economy is somebody else's problem.

runner_topan_tide_of_omore.name: Tide of Omore
runner_topan_tide_of_omore.description: Topan. Militant. She brings the tide. Your ICE is temporary infrastructure.

runner_padma_threading.name: Threading the Environment
runner_padma_threading.description: Padma. Explorer. She charts routes through your architecture no one else has found.

runner_magdalene_fermented_future.name: Fermented Future
runner_magdalene_fermented_future.description: Magdalene. Patient. She is cultivating access to something you have not noticed yet.

runner_muslihat_cezve_revolver.name: Cezve Revolver
runner_muslihat_cezve_revolver.description: MuslihaT. She has refined her trade. Every access point has a price.

runner_vic_red_act.name: Red Act
runner_vic_red_act.description: Vic. No hesitation. No wasted motion. A perfect run every time.

runner_esa_steeling_keiko.name: Steeling Keiko
runner_esa_steeling_keiko.description: Esa. Eco-insurrectionist. She runs on principle and spite.

runner_ryo_classy_fire.name: Classy Fire
runner_ryo_classy_fire.description: Ryo. Burning bright. Every server she cracks fuels the next.

runner_padma_dr_nuka.name: Dr. Nuka
runner_padma_dr_nuka.description: Padma. She has a specialist now. Nuka closes gaps you did not know existed.

runner_dewi_self_modifying_pinhole.name: Self-Modifying Pinhole
runner_dewi_self_modifying_pinhole.description: Dewi. She adapts faster than your ICE can respond. The lesson is never free.

runner_ryo_takas_cookbook.name: Taka's Cookbook
runner_ryo_takas_cookbook.description: Ryo. Taka and Cookbook. She does not stop. She cannot be stopped.

runner_esa_tungsten_carnivore.name: Tungsten Carnivore
runner_esa_tungsten_carnivore.description: Esa. Steel and biology. Your ICE is infrastructure. She unmakes infrastructure.

runner_barry_sang_curu.name: Sang Curu
runner_barry_sang_curu.description: Barry. New tools. Same business model. Run, score, repeat.

runner_mercury_mystic_shibboleth.name: Mystic Shibboleth
runner_mercury_mystic_shibboleth.description: Mercury. Fastest runner on the network. She does not wait for ICE to fire.

runner_magdalene_future_freedom_flow.name: Future Freedom Flow
runner_magdalene_future_freedom_flow.description: Magdalene. She has seen the architecture. She is building a door.

runner_arissana_lilypad_gamble.name: The Lilypad Gamble
runner_arissana_lilypad_gamble.description: Arissana. Street artist. She tags your servers with programs you cannot see until they fire.

runner_hiram_nosferatu.name: Nosferatu
runner_hiram_nosferatu.description: Hiram. He has been inside your systems longer than you know. He is ending this himself.

runner_loup_midnight_wolf.name: Midnight Wolf
runner_loup_midnight_wolf.description: Loup. In the dark. He does not need to see the ICE to break it.

runner_vic_courage.name: Courage
runner_vic_courage.description: Vic. She has been watching the Syndicate for years. This is the final accounting.

runner_loup_devil_wears_chisel.name: This Devil Wears Chisel
runner_loup_devil_wears_chisel.description: Loup. Dressed to kill. Every program he wears is a weapon.

runner_esa_face.name: Face
runner_esa_face.description: Esa. The last runner standing. She is not running for profit. She is running for everyone.

runner_arissana_trojan_exe.name: Trojan.Exe
runner_arissana_trojan_exe.description: Arissana. Her art lives in your servers now. You cannot remove it without crashing everything.
